steps.caption: Open Find contacts from the More menu.
Find people: three ways to bring in new people.
Web search needs an AI key; your own LinkedIn connections export works without one.
Choose your Connections.csv and keep 'Only CRE-relevant roles' ticked.
Press Import. People go to 'To review' — not into your records yet.
Rohan Kulkarni, Head of Facilities at Zentrix — a decision-maker. Approve him.
Open Your contacts → he is listed with his role.
What we know, field by field: each has its own status — Reported, Inferred or Missing.
The score shows how relevant this contact is for office decisions.
CRE relevance: assessed from his title as a Decision-maker — confirm it, with a reason.
Press Correct role to save the verified role.
Has a business email you confirmed? It appears under contact details with 'Mark verified'.
